errors.evidence: The description states that the 'Внос' (Import) line increases to about 66% in 2016, but the figure shows it peaking at approximately 65%. The other two lines reach 66% in that year.

The description states that the 'Износ' (Export) line remains around 61-62% until 2008. However, the line shows a notable drop from ~62.5% in 2004 to ~60.5% in 2007 and 2008. The description oversimplifies this trend.
